stories.title: Microsoft’s Agent Framework PyPI package compromised to steal credentials
stories.summary: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI, publishing two malicious versions designed to steal cloud credentials and other sensitive information from developers' systems.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
